==Fight the Pirate ship==
* {{Winning|destroyed=true|With the pirate ship destroyed, your ship's system is restored to full functionality. You salvage what you can from the debris.}}
** You receive a random amount of [[Rewards#Fuel|fuel and scrap]].
* {{Winning|deadCrew=true|With the pirate ship disabled, your engines come online again. You salvage what you can from their ship.}}
** You receive {{tooltip|medium|2-4 fuel}} [[Rewards#Fuel|fuel and scrap]].

==Trivia==
This event is called "PIRATE_NO_ESCAPE" in the datafiles. 
* The ship ("PIRATE_NO_ESCAPE") doesn't surrender nor tries to escape.
* Level 1 Engines system is not affected by the enemy hack, hence the crew skill can be trained.
